Name: Simple Fishing
Author: Cavalieredraghi
Description:
This mod is to make the fishing mini-game simple.  as it attempts to make all the fish super easy to catch, where you have to put in little to no effort. I know when I first starting to play Stardew the fishing mini-game was the only thing that I dreaded. While this won't be for everyone, those who also dislike fishing enjoy it. 

It is following in the example of Pratzelwurm's "Simple Fishing Mod". I have not tested to see if their pufferfish bug is solved yet, but I hope I found the issue that they were experiencing and resolved it. I also updated it so it is good to go from Stardew Valley 1.6. Though I have not tested the other Language files, especially for any fish after 1.4. 

As a result of it being an XNB file, it should not require SMAPI. I am going to work on a SMAPI version as I am aware that they are not the recommend mods to use per SMAPI, and I completely understand why. Please bear with me as I attempt that.
